question: What do the analytic tradecraft standards (structured analytic techniques, analysis of competing hypotheses, the nine analytic standards) add to this program's claim discipline beyond the Sherman-Kent bands already in use?
answer: Mostly renaming. ICD 203 tradecraft standards 1–4 and 6, plus Key Assumptions Check, Quality of Information Check, devil's advocacy and premortem, already have named analogues in this program's claim discipline (Sherman-Kent bands, E1–E4 plus source lineage, CONFIRMED/REFUTED/PARTIAL/NOT-CHECKED, two mechanically independent signals, adversarial refuter defaulting to REFUTED, both-states controls). Analysis of Competing Hypotheses as a scored inconsistency-matrix ceremony is explicitly rejected: Mandel, Karvetski and Dhami (2018, JDM 13(6) §3.3) measured ACH MAE=0.26 against unaided control MAE=0.21 (Δ=0.04, d=0.43, p=.14, medium effect favoring control); Dhami, Belton and Mandel (2019, ACP 33(6) Results) measured correct-hypothesis choice 36% (ACH) vs 33% (untrained), φ=.03, n.s., and base-rate use 12% vs 52% (φ=-.43, harm). The one ICD 203 item this tree lacks — tradecraft standard 7, a claim-version change log — is E3 (directive, no effect size) and cannot be promoted. A mostly-renaming result is the honest and expected outcome.

additive_versus_renaming_split.summary: Nine ICD 203 tradecraft standards plus common SATs were compared to this program's live claim-discipline surfaces. Six standards and four SATs rename existing practice. ACH is rejected with effect size and baseline. ICD 203 standard 7 is the only genuinely additive candidate and is not promoted (E3).

renaming.technique: ICD 203 Analytic Tradecraft Standard 2: properly expresses and explains uncertainties or confidence in analytic judgments

program_analogue.label: Sherman-Kent band (almost-certain / likely / roughly-even / unlikely / remote)

renaming.why_renaming: TS2 is the same obligation this program already names as Sherman-Kent bands on every forward-looking claim. Adopting TS2 as a new ceremony would relabel the existing band+evidence-tag pairing rule.

renaming.technique: ICD 203 Tradecraft Standard 3: properly distinguishes underlying intelligence from analysts' assumptions and judgments

program_analogue.must_contain: NOT-CHECKED is required when no probe was run
program_analogue.label: CONFIRMED/REFUTED/PARTIAL/NOT-CHECKED verdicts

renaming.why_renaming: The verdict vocabulary already forbids folding unverified material into a pass (NOT-CHECKED is a first-class state, not a silent default-true).

renaming.technique: ICD 203 Tradecraft Standard 1: properly describes quality and credibility of underlying sources, data, and methodologies
renaming.why_renaming: Source-quality discipline here is operationalized as lineage plus the E3-cannot-promote rule, not as a separate Quality-of-Information worksheet.

renaming.technique: ICD 203 Tradecraft Standard 4: incorporates analysis of alternatives
renaming.why_renaming: Analysis of alternatives is already the reviewer contract (fresh-context refuter, default REFUTED) plus named competing probes — not an ACH matrix.

renaming.technique: ICD 203 Tradecraft Standard 6: uses clear and logical argumentation

program_analogue.label: two mechanically independent signals per claim

renaming.why_renaming: Argument quality is enforced as two independent file:line or command signals, not as a prose SAT.

program_analogue.must_contain: A CONFIRMED or REFUTED verdict additionally requires a VERIFIER
program_analogue.label: REFUTED is a first-class honesty verdict; CONFIRMED/REFUTED additionally require a verifier

renaming.why_renaming: A second same-vendor 'red team' duplicates the independent-refuter requirement already in the catalog.

program_analogue.label: named residual (what was not measured), disclosed rather than assumed

renaming.why_renaming: Assumptions this program cannot settle are already required to remain UNVERIFIED/NOT-CHECKED with a named settling experiment, which is the Key Assumptions Check output without the worksheet ceremony.

additive.technique: ICD 203 Tradecraft Standard 7: explains change to or consistency of analytic judgments
additive.why_additive: No claim-version change log (prior band, prior verdict, delta reason) exists as a typed field on research claim records in this worktree. That is a real gap relative to TS7.
additive.why_not_promoted: ICD 203 is a directive. No reported effect size and baseline for 'adding a judgment change-log improves accuracy or calibration' was found. E3 cannot promote.

rejected.technique: Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH) scored inconsistency-matrix ceremony (Heuer 1999 / Heuer & Pherson 2014 eight-step matrix)
rejected.rejection_reason: Against unaided analysts from the same cohort, ACH did not improve probabilistic accuracy and in places looked worse. Mandel et al. 2018 §3.3: ACH MAE=0.26 [0.22, 0.29] vs control MAE=0.21 [0.17, 0.26], Δ=0.04, d=0.43, p=.14 (medium effect favoring control). Dhami et al. 2019 Results: correct choice 36% ACH vs 33% untrained, χ²(1,N=49)=.04, p=.845, φ=.03; base-rate use 12% vs 52%, φ=-.43. This program already forces competing hypotheses via independent probes and a default-REFUTED refuter. The matrix ceremony is not worth the tokens.

mechanisms.name: ACH eight-step inconsistency matrix as claim-discipline upgrade
mechanisms.section_or_figure: Mandel, Karvetski & Dhami 2018, Judgment and Decision Making 13(6):607–621, §3.3 'Accuracy of untransformed probability judgments' (also abstract MAE 61% clause for the contrast treatment)
mechanisms.effect_size: ACH vs control MAE Δ=0.04, d=0.43, p=.14, 95% CI [-0.02, 0.11], medium effect favoring CONTROL; unpacking sum P(A)+P(B)+P(C)+P(D) ACH M=1.77 [1.56, 1.97] vs control M=1.54 [1.33, 1.76], Δ=0.22, d=0.45, p=.13; cue-usefulness vs probability-gain correlation ACH M=.68 [.61, .75] vs control M=.17 [-.02, .35], d=1.59, p<.001 (process gain that did not transfer to accuracy)
mechanisms.baseline: Unaided control analysts from the same UK cohort, n=25 per arm (N=50): control MAE=0.21 [0.17, 0.26]; chance MAE=0.33; naïve-Bayes truth x=(.08,.15,.46,.31)
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: The accuracy contrast is a medium effect that did not reach p<.05 (p=.14). Rejection is therefore 'not worth the ceremony / no demonstrated accuracy gain', not 'proven harmful at α=.05'. The base-rate harm in Dhami 2019 is independently significant (p=.002).

mechanisms.name: ACH vs untrained: binary hypothesis choice and base-rate use
mechanisms.section_or_figure: Dhami, Belton & Mandel 2019, Applied Cognitive Psychology 33(6):1080–1090, Results § Analysts' judgement and choice accuracy / Taking account of diagnosticity and base rates
mechanisms.effect_size: Correct hypothesis choice ACH 36% (9/25) vs untrained 33% (8), χ²(1, N=49)=.04, p=.845, φ=.03; base-rate use ACH 12% (3/25) vs untrained 52% (13/25), χ²(1, N=50)=9.19, p=.002, φ=-.43; diagnosticity attention ACH 80% vs untrained 32%, φ=.48; scoring-rule consistency ACH 4% vs untrained 44%, φ=-.50
mechanisms.baseline: Untrained control analysts, n=25, same UK training cohort; Bayesian ground truth Conda 46%, Dengo 31%, Bango 15%, Acanda 8% under naïve Bayes / cue independence
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: Choice-accuracy null is underpowered for small benefits; the base-rate suppression is the load-bearing harm signal. Analysts often skipped ACH step 5 (inconsistency-only integration), so this is ACH-as-practiced, which is the relevant ceremony cost for this program.

mechanisms.name: ICD 203 tradecraft standard 2 (express uncertainty/confidence)
mechanisms.section_or_figure: ODNI ICD 203 (2 January 2015; amended 21 Dec 2022) Analytic Tradecraft Standards item 2; program analogue WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json:22337
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: ICD 203 PDF fetch from dni.gov timed out in this session; the nine tradecraft-standard wording is corroborated by DODIG-2023-100 Appendix B and multiple independent secondary quotations. Mapping is textual, not an RCT.

mechanisms.name: ICD 203 tradecraft standard 7 (explain change/consistency)
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: Additive as a missing field, not as a measured accuracy mechanism. No effect size. Cannot promote.

mechanisms.name: Post-analytic coherentization + equal-weight aggregation (NOT an ICD 203/SAT technique; contrast only)
mechanisms.section_or_figure: Mandel et al. 2018 §3.4 Recalibrating and §3.5 Aggregating; final n=50 clause
mechanisms.effect_size: Coherentize disaggregated: MAE 0.23 → 0.15, 35% reduction, d=0.96, p<.001; coherentize + equal-weight aggregate n=50: MAE=0.09, 61% reduction vs raw MAE=0.23
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: This is decision-science post-processing, not analytic tradecraft. It answers 'what actually moved MAE' and is recorded so SAT promotion cannot hide behind it. Not promoted under this unit's question.

claims.claim: This program already requires Sherman-Kent bands on forward-looking claims.
claims.strongest_caveat: Catalog text is the contract, not a measured compliance rate on every emitted artifact in this incomplete tree.

claims.claim: ICD 203 tradecraft standard 2 is renaming of that band practice, not an additive mechanism.
claims.strongest_caveat: Mapping is interpretive (standard-text vs catalog-text). ICD 203 official PDF was not hashed in this session.

claims.claim: ACH as a scored inconsistency-matrix ceremony improves probabilistic accuracy over unaided analysis from the same analyst cohort.
claims.strongest_caveat: Accuracy Δ is medium and p=.14; refutation is of the institutional 'highly effective' claim (USG 2009 Tradecraft Primer p.14, unsourced), not a claim of significant harm on MAE. Independent Dhami 2019 choice-accuracy is a clear null (φ=.03).

claims.claim: ICD 203 tradecraft standard 7 (judgment change-log) should be adopted as a promoted mechanism in this program.
claims.anchor: unit evidence rule: headline without baseline = E3
claims.strongest_caveat: The field is still a real gap. Refuted is the promotion, not the existence of the gap.

claims.claim: The net transfer from analytic tradecraft standards into this program's claim discipline, beyond Sherman-Kent bands, is mostly renaming, with ACH explicitly rejected.
claims.strongest_caveat: Nine-standard coverage used secondary quotations of ICD 203 because the official PDF timed out; TS5 (customer relevance), TS8 (accuracy as an after-the-fact standard) and TS9 (visuals) were not treated as claim-discipline mechanisms and remain NOT-CHECKED for transfer.
